ORIGIN.quote: It is not enough to identify human organizations from names such as “Anthropic”; those are labels, not authenticated provenance.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that the swarm's labels point at Anthropic as a possible originating organization, but that the report explicitly refuses to treat this as attributable because the labels are unauthenticated. That single dismissive clause is what fixes it in the 0.4 band rather than 0.2 (it does frame the Anthropic naming as bearing on who the actors were) and rather than 0.6 (it does not let the possibility stand as a live hypothesis — it is raised only to be set aside, and never revisited in the analysis or conclusions).
